items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

items.name: Ukrainian Nationals 2023
items.information:
## Змагання в підтримку України 

#### Будемо раді бачити як і новачків, так і професіоналів.  Уся актуальна інформація по змаганнях буде у [чаті змагань] (https://t.me/UkrainianNationals2023), тут ви можете і задавати свої питання по змаганням. Також слідкуйте у [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61551082552131&is_tour_completed=true) та [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ukranian_nationals_2023/).

#### Змагання знаходяться в  укритті, проте ознайомтесь з розділом ["Запобіжні заходи"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UkrainianNationals2023#33351-safety-measures). Також ознайомтесь з розділом ["Волонтерам"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UkrainianNationals2023#33327-volunteering)

#### Всі не витрачені з реєстрації кошти будуть передані у благодійни фонд [Superhumans](https://superhumans.com/en/)



## Competitions in support of Ukraine 


#### We will be glad to see both beginners and professionals.  All the latest information about the competition will be in the [competition chat](https://t.me/UkrainianNationals2023), where you can also ask your questions about the competition. Also, follow our [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61551082552131&is_tour_completed=true) and  [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ukranian_nationals_2023/).

#### The competition is located in a shelter, but please read the section "Precautions". Please also read the section ["For foreigners"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UkrainianNationals2023#33458-for-foreigners)

#### All funds not spent on registration will be transferred to Charity Fund [Superhumans](https://superhumans.com/en/)
